summary: County camping page, all 10 site pages, reservation policy, alerts and campground map read. Confirmed 10 non-electric sites (pads 12x30 to 14x58 ft), hand-pump water, May 1-Nov 30, $20 + $10 reservation fee, county booking engine 184 days ahead, 14 nights max. No dump on site (Goodman Park). WATERFRONT LEAD riverfront -> riverview (canopy; channel ~22-30 m). ATV riding allowed (general campground, flag only). Pin fine, phone and website confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade): stored riverfront (2026-06 sweep, not --AWH) -> riverview. The county map puts site 7 at the bank (~10 m) and sites 4 and 6 about 20-30 m from the river, with 1, 2, 3 nearer the road and 5, 8, 9, 10 inside the loop. On Esri imagery the whole loop (between County Road I and the river, ~45.4768,-88.3286) is under continuous conifer canopy right to the water, so no site shows open ground to the river; the only opening is the day-use clearing ~45.4772,-88.3290 north of the loop. The Peshtigo here shows ~22-24 m of open water between the canopy edges at 45.4766,-88.3298 (zoom 19) and ~30 m at most bank to bank, so it is creek-size by the 30 m rule as well. Sites 4, 6 and 7 are all sold by the night (site 7 by reservation only). No official site photo found; campendium refused (403). If the reviewer wants an on-water value for site 7 at the bank, creekside is the size-correct one, not riverfront. Proposed evidence: 'County map + Esri imagery: site 7 at the bank, 4 and 6 ~20-30 m, all under continuous canopy; Peshtigo ~22-30 m wide at the campground - riverview --Claude'.

OHV: 'Riding ATV/UTV's in any Marinette County Park is prohibited with the exception of McClintock Park Campground' and the page calls it 'the only Marinette County Park that is ATV/UTV accessible'. A 10-site general rustic county campground with ATV riding allowed, not a staging area or trail-system base; flag only.
PIN: stored 45.4768,-88.3296 sits at the river end of the loop (by site 7); the loop centroid is about 45.4768,-88.3286, ~80 m east. Fine.
